programme.desc: Review bursts into life with Matchweek 1 of the 2025/26 Premier League with a blockbuster Sunday showdown as Manchester United host Arsenal at Old Trafford.

programme.title: PL Stories: Ep09: the Ipswich Way Ep09
programme.desc: From the trailblazing success of Sir Alf Ramsey's league champions to Sir Bobby Robson's unforgettable FA Cup and UEFA Cup triumphs, this is the story of one of English football's most cherished clubs.

programme.title: PL Stories: Ep08: a Family United Ep08
programme.desc: 'A Family United', tells the story of the Singh brothers; lifelong Manchester United fans who have followed the club through every twist of its Premier League journey.

programme.title: PL Stories: Ep07: Norwich, the Nearly Men Ep07
programme.desc: We take a trip down memory lane to revisit the incredible story of Norwich City's unforgettable 1992-93 season.

programme.title: PL Stories: Ep06: Dean Ashton Ep06
programme.desc: We spend the day with Dean Ashton as he reflects on a career that promised so much and was cut short far too soon.

programme.title: PL Stories: Ep05: Diogo Jota Ep05
programme.desc: One year on from the tragic death of Diogo Jota and his brother Andre in a car accident, this deeply emotional PL Stories show celebrates the life of one of football's most loved figures.

programme.title: PL Stories: Ep04: Soaring Seagulls Ep04
programme.desc: 'Soaring Seagulls' tells the incredible story of Brighton and Hove Albion; from the brink of collapse and years in the lower leagues to becoming one of the Premier League's smartest and most admired clubs.

programme.title: PL Stories: Ep03: Julian Dicks Ep03
programme.desc: We spend the day with Julian Dicks as he reflects on a career that made him one of the Premier League's toughest and most uncompromising defenders.

programme.title: PL Stories: Ep02: Pochettino's Spurs Ep02
programme.desc: Ahead of the World Cup, we revisit the rise of current USA manager Mauricio Pochettino's unforgettable Tottenham Hotspur side.

programme.title: PL Stories: Ep01: Lee Bowyer Ep01

programme.title: Premier League 2025/26
programme.desc: Between 2017-18 and 2023-24, Brighton and Hove Albion only avoided defeat in two of 14 Premier League games against Man City (W1 D1 L12); last season, they didn’t lose against City, winning 2-1 at home and drawing 2-2 at the Etihad.

programme.title: Premier League 2025/26
programme.desc: West Ham have won both of their last two Premier League games and are looking to win three in a row in the competition for the first time since December 2023.

programme.title: Premier League 2025/26
programme.desc: Newcastle haven’t scored in any of their last four Premier League matches without Alexander Isak featuring (D2 L2), having 47 shots and accumulating an xG of 5.57 without scoring in these games.

programme.title: Premier League 2025/26
programme.desc: Manchester City have won five of their last eight Premier League matches against Manchester United (D1 L2), though they failed to win either game (D1 L1) last season for the first time since 2020-21.

programme.title: Premier League 2025/26
programme.desc: Arsenal have won five of their last six Premier League games against Tottenham (D1), including the last three in a row. It’s their longest winning run against Spurs since a five game stretch between January 1987 and January 1989.

programme.title: Premier League 2025/26
programme.desc: Chelsea have won five of their last seven Premier League meetings with West Ham United (D1 L1), and overall have 32 wins in the competition against the Hammers, only beating Spurs more often (37).

programme.title: Premier League 2025/26
programme.desc: Crystal Palace are looking to remain unbeaten for a 13th consecutive Premier League game, which would set a new club record for unbeaten top-flight league games – the Eagles also had a 12 match run between May and October 1990.

programme.title: Premier League 2025/26
programme.desc: Brighton completed a Premier League double over Tottenham Hotspur last season – the only time they have ever won back-to-back league meetings with Spurs.

programme.title: Premier League 2025/26
programme.desc: Antoine Semenyo has scored (10) or assisted (4) 14 of Bournemouth’s last 18 Premier League goals (78%). Since the start of this period (14th April), this is at least three more goal involvements than any other player in the division.

programme.title: Premier League 2025/26
programme.desc: Erling Haaland has scored 48 goals in 48 home Premier League appearances for Man City. The only player to hit 50 Premier League home goals in fewer than 50 appearances is Alan Shearer, who scored his 50th home goal in his 47th game.

programme.title: Premier League 2025/26
programme.desc: Newcastle have kept four clean sheets in their five Premier League games this season, conceding only in their 3-2 defeat to Liverpool. However, the Magpies have also failed to score in three of their five league games so far.

programme.title: Premier League 2025/26

programme.title: Premier League 2025/26

programme.title: Premier League 2025/26

programme.title: Premier League 2025/26

programme.title: Premier League 2025/26

programme.title: Premier League 2025/26

programme.title: Jaws vs. the Blob
programme.desc: A phenomenon known as "The Blob" sends juvenile great whites into a gauntlet of giant 20-foot adults in the midst of a feeding frenzy off the coast of Guadalupe Island; experts dive deep to learn whether the young sharks survive or become a snack.

programme.title: Great White Danger Zone
programme.desc: Alison Towner and her team investigate a new great white-hot spot off the coast of South Africa; it is equipped with cutting-edge fin cameras, tracking tags and underwater surveillance; researchers unveil unusual behavior in these great whites.

programme.title: Expedition Unknown: Megalodon
programme.desc: Josh Gates travels to Mexico and South Africa in search of fossilized megalodon teeth; alongside fellow paleontologists and shark experts, Josh dives into shark-infested waters to find out what happened to the mighty "Meg.".

programme.title: Mako Mania: Battle for California
programme.desc: Off the coast of Los Angeles, a new population of super makos is challenging great whites for hunting territories; Dr. Craig O'Connell, Fo Zayed, and Kendyl Bernet deploy state-of-the-art technology to reveal their dominance.

programme.title: Jurassic Sharks
programme.desc: Prehistoric sharks rise from the dead as biologists investigate the superpredators that ruled the seas. Global expeditions yield new evidence of the strangest sharks to ever roam the ocean, and groundbreaking CGI technology brings them back to life.

programme.title: Shark Frenzy: Mating Games
programme.desc: Dr. Craig O'Connell and his team willfully ignite shark-feeding frenzies to uncover whether these violent and chaotic events trigger mating behavior; the results could be the key to ensuring the survival of these crucial apex species.

programme.title: Expedition X
programme.desc: Josh Gates sends Phil and Heather on their riskiest mission yet: tracking a legendary 20-foot shark lurking in the eerie waters off Colombia's Malpelo Island; after seeing chilling footage, Josh tasks his team with uncovering the predator's identity.

programme.title: Expedition Unknown
programme.desc: Just off Florida's coast, Josh Gates braves shark-infested waters in search of an American ship sunk by a Nazi U-boat during WWII; Josh joins Tristan Guttridge who has a bold new strategy to use sharks as spies to uncover the wreck.

programme.title: Expedition X
programme.desc: Phil and Heather investigate disturbing reports of aggressive mutant sharks in Micronesia's Marshall Islands. Joined by an international team of scientists, they dive in dangerous waters to explore whether the region's terrifying atomic past is to blame.

programme.title: Expedition Unknown
programme.desc: Josh Gates investigates the USS Indianapolis disaster, which led to the deadliest shark attack in history, explores the mystery of Scotland's Stronsay Beast, and examines ancient remains that may reveal the earliest confirmed shark attack ever recorded.

programme.title: Alien Sharks: Untamed America
programme.desc: Wildlife biologist Forrest Galante searches for America's strangest alien sharks, traveling from California and Louisiana to Key Largo and Cape Cod in a cross-country celebration of the nation's 250th anniversary.

programme.title: Jaws vs. Orca
programme.desc: Great white sharks are under siege by orcas; experts push into dangerous waters off the coast of Spain, provoking attacks on their boats to reveal how killer whales dominate their deadliest rival.

programme.desc: Phil and Heather investigate disturbing reports of aggressive mutant sharks in Micronesia's Marshall Islands. Joined by an international team of scientists, they dive in dangerous waters to explore whether the region's terrifying atomic past is to blame.

programme.title: Alien Sharks: Untamed America
programme.desc: Wildlife biologist Forrest Galante searches for America's strangest alien sharks, traveling from California and Louisiana to Key Largo and Cape Cod in a cross-country celebration of the nation's 250th anniversary.

programme.title: Jaws vs. Orca
programme.desc: Great white sharks are under siege by orcas; experts push into dangerous waters off the coast of Spain, provoking attacks on their boats to reveal how killer whales dominate their deadliest rival.

programme.title: Sharks of the Dead Zone
programme.desc: Dr. Tiara Moore has discovered bull sharks thriving in polluted, algae filled lagoons; teaming up with Dr. Craig O'Connell, they study why pregnant females still migrate there and how their pups survive in a seemingly hostile environment.

programme.title: Deadly Sharks of Paradise
programme.desc: With 60 attacks in 30 years, Brazil has become a hotspot for lethal shark encounters; marine biologist Danni Washington and conservationist Paul de Gelder join scientists tracking tiger sharks in one of Brazil's tourist destinations.

programme.title: Alien Sharks: First Contact
programme.desc: Mysterious and bizarre alien sharks lurk far beneath the waves in deep waters where researchers are on a quest to make first contact; pursuing the elusive frilled shark, sleeper shark and cookie cutter shark brings even more unexpected encounters.

programme.title: Guy Fieri's Feeding Frenzy
programme.desc: Guy and his son, Hunter, head to the Bahamas to experience local cuisine and explore the waters around these islands, while discovering what makes them the perfect all-you-can-eat buffet for a wide variety of shark species.

programme.title: Florida's Death Beach
programme.desc: Welcome to New Smyrna Beach, Florida's spring break hotspot and the Shark Attack Capital of the World; wildlife biologist Forrest Galante investigates to figure out why this party spot has become so deadly before more blood ends up in the water.

programme.title: The Real Sharkano
programme.desc: Shark Week star Paul De Gelder is taking a small team to an ultra remote island of shark worshiping natives to see if their secret ways of swimming with deadly sharks could hold the secret to humans and sharks living together in peace.

programme.title: Stranger Sharks
programme.desc: Mark Rober and Noah Schnapp from "Stranger Things" are teaming up for the ultimate Shark Week adventure; exploring abandoned undersea ruins and man-made artificial reefs searching for the strangest sharks in the ocean.

programme.title: Monster Hammerheads: Species X
programme.desc: Dr. Austin Gallagher and his team investigate an aggressive population of hammerhead sharks in Turks and Caicos; they could be an entirely new species.

programme.title: Jaws vs. Kraken
